title: Clip judgement — structured output returned by the taste model

genre_confidence.description: Does this match the genre config's must_see_any and violate no exclude? <0.8 is an automatic reject.

genre_evidence.description: Which visual cue was actually seen. Forces the model to ground the call.

slot.description: Which act of the two-act format this can fill.

punch_timestamp.description: Seconds into the source video where the punch lands.

suggested_in_out.description: [in, out] seconds. Target 2-6s, landing on the punch within 1s of `in`.

crop_safe.description: Does the joke survive a 9:16 centre crop of a 16:9 source?

escalation_severity.description: For last_day ordering only. How big is the disaster.

risk_flags.description: ANY flag here routes to manual review. possible_real_injury is a hard reject.
